title: A retuned exact norm-one circuit bound with logarithmic loss

claims.statement: Joint CircuitBreaker theorem under rules.md: the following declaration defines ONE fixed eligible total uniform NP family in the pinned full B2 model at actual input length n. Its full guarantee and its declared projection both hold unconditionally, for all sufficiently large integer lengths with the quantifiers specified by the theorem kinds. Both score source claims assert this ENTIRE declaration, not separate lemmas. Let L(n)=c*n^p*(log2 n)^q*(log2 log2 n)^r with the exact parameters in guarantee.leading. Let h(n)=n^exponent*(log2 n)^log_exponent*(log2 log2 n)^loglog_exponent with the exact parameters in guarantee.remainder. There exist a fixed real K>0 and N such that C_B2(f_n)>=L(n)-K*h(n) for every integer n>=N. K is existential, not a specified coefficient. experiments.purpose: Initial positive replay reconstructs all 4,489 negative endpoint cell means from first principles and compares every entry, verifies the radial enclosure and both positive roots. Request the complementary input {"part":"negative"} to verify the other two roots, all five centers and both rays using the now-certified table. The two parts are jointly necessary.
